paraphrase: In Aquinas’s historical account of rape as a species of lust, forcible unlawful violation of a virgin is included; the classification also includes some abductions with the woman’s consent and abducted widows and nonvirgins and treats violence by a newly married husband as sinful while excluding it from this particular rape category. This is not a general definition of nonconsensual sexual violation.
